verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of a reporting dashboard or analytics view showing dispute rate, false-positive rate, approval-rate lift or review workload, and nothing on exporting such metrics. The REST API for retrieving data, the chargeback and representment event endpoints, and the marketing lines about approving more transactions and authorization-rate optimization are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not the finance reporting capability itself.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can see the numbers that matter — dispute rate, false-positive rate, approval-rate lift, review workload — and export them for the board
